C0457.title: Shenzhen Futian Police Crack Down on Fraud-Linked Illicit SIM Supply Chain
C0457.summary: In August 2021, Shenzhen police stated at an anti-fraud press conference that they were carrying out special operations against telecom-fraud gray-market chains, including illicit mobile SIM cards and GOIP devices that supplied communication resources to overseas fraud dens. The case shows how the acquisition, stockpiling, and resale of illicit SIM cards can support traffic diversion, account registration, and remote control in telecom and online fraud. Although the public notice focused on the broader anti-fraud campaign, it shows that governance of fraud-related communication resources has expanded from individual-number handling to card sources, devices, storage, and resale chains, requiring coordination among operators, police, and platform risk controls.
